name: Canberra Fire Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage South Canberra lists restored fire appliances, free entry; but open Saturday 10-14 only.
objection: Open one morning a week and a small volunteer museum, so it is not there whenever you arrive; one source only.

name: Canberra Reptile Zoo
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Gungahlin and Visit Canberra family-fun both name it; daily 10-5, reptile displays and Snake Tales program (rule 2 permanent venue).
objection: It is a commercial zoo in a strip of attractions; the Gold Creek Village precinct might be the single draw. Kept as a place with its own entry and hours.

name: Canberra Walk-in Aviary
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Gungahlin and Visit Canberra name it; 500+ birds, 60 species, feed them, open daily.
objection: Small family attraction a few doors from the Reptile Zoo; near-duplicate precinct; one-hour visit.

name: Ginninderra Village
reason: Rule 3: Wikivoyage entry is a remnant-of-Ginninderra note within the Gold Creek Village precinct; shops and gardens, nothing named to do (and its own heritage note refers to the schoolhouse).
objection: Wikivoyage does list it as a see item; but it is part of the Gold Creek Village precinct and has no distinct visit.

name: Gungahlin Enclosed Oval
reason: Rule 2: sports venue, no tour or museum named.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it under See; but it is only a ground for local clubs.

name: Gold Creek Country Club
reason: Rule 2/COVERAGE: golf course and club, a business not a visitor place.
objection: Public play permitted and Wikivoyage lists it; still a golf club.

name: Goorooyarroo Nature Reserve
reason: Rule 1/2: ACT parks agency page (via parks-act-leads, Canberra Nature Park; relied on the agency lead list) names woodland reserve with walking tracks and picnic areas.
objection: Adjoins Mulligans Flat (a bigger draw) and the note says Wikipedia only; thin visitor detail; one counted source.

name: Gossan Hill
reason: Rule 1/2: ACT Government walks list (act.gov.au Feb 2026 'great Canberra walks') names a 2.5 km loop in a 47 ha nature reserve; Ginninderry and HerCanberra describe it as a short walk with views.
objection: Short walk, one government list source, no distinct lookout confirmed; the lengths disagree (1.7 vs 2.5 km). Cannot open the agency page.

name: One Tree Hill Lookout
reason: Rule 1/2/3: Wikivoyage Hall and Gungahlin plus Visit Canberra (100 things, a popular Centenary Trail section) name the hilltop lookout; about one hour walk each way; it is a hill/lookout separate from the Centenary Trail section.
objection: It sits on the Centenary Trail, which the list may also carry; a lookout on a track. Kept because three sources single it out.

name: Hall Heritage Walk
reason: Rule 3: self-guided walk of 20 houses in Hall, duplicate of the Hall village listing; Wikivoyage itself says Hall has little to see and it is a stop list, not a distinct place.
objection: The National Trust walk is a named route; but its stops are ordinary houses and the village is covered by Hall.

name: Hall School Museum and Heritage Centre
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Hall lists the local museum in the former primary school (bush school history).
objection: Open Thursday mornings and Sunday afternoons only, small, one source; not there whenever you arrive.

name: Hall Showground
reason: Rule 2/4: showground used for markets and events; Wikivoyage itself says there is not much, nothing to see on a regular day.
objection: A venue that merely hosts events; the markets are monthly.

name: Hall Park
reason: Duplicate/ordinary park: Wikivoyage says the two Hall parks are pretty ordinary with nothing unique (same as Hall Village Reserve).
objection: None strong; listed as see item.

name: Hall Village Christmas Fair and Street Party
reason: Rule 4: annual event, not a permanent place.
objection: Visit Canberra promotes it; but timing makes it unsuitable as a spot.

name: Canberra Yacht Club Boat and SUP Hire
reason: Operator/hire business, not a place (COVERAGE: spot is a place).
objection: Lake access point; but the place is the lake.

name: GoBoat Canberra
reason: Operator: boat hire on Lake Burley Griffin.
objection: Two counted sources; still a hire operator.

name: Lake Burley Griffin Cruises
reason: Operator/cruise; also listed as temporarily suspended; the place is the lake.
objection: Two sources name cruises; but the way you get there, not a place.

name: Love Boats Canberra
reason: Operator: boat hire.
objection: Same as GoBoat.

name: MV Southern Cross
reason: A vessel/cruise, not a place.
objection: Visit Canberra names it; but rule: vehicle or ferry is not a spot.

name: YMCA Canberra Paddle Hub
reason: Operator: group-only paddle hire, seasonal bookings of 10-28 people.
objection: Gives lake access; but a hire service.

name: Bridge to Bridge Loop
reason: Rule 1/3: Visit Canberra 100 things names the 5 km walk past the War Memorial and Parliament House; locals' favourite.
objection: It is a route around parts of Lake Burley Griffin and passes sights listed on their own (War Memorial, Parliament House), so near-duplicate of the lake; one counted source.

name: Lake Ginninderra
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen names the 105 ha lake with a 7 km path, lakeside parks and the Emu Bank foreshore (lake spot, the path is part of it).
objection: A suburban lake that mostly locals use; one source.

name: Lake Ginninderra Shared Path
reason: Part of Lake Ginninderra: the 7 km loop is the lake's own path.
objection: Two counted sources (Visit Canberra cycling too); but same place as the lake.

name: Evatt Wetlands and Ginninderra Creek Trail
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen describes an eco-restored creek reserve with wetlands and trail, free car park.
objection: Local nature trail with one source; may be part of the Lake Ginninderra area; not a headline walk.

name: Umbagong District Park Grinding Grooves
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen names the protected Aboriginal grinding grooves site in the creek bed, open 24 hours.
objection: Small site, one source, could be a short stop; sensitive heritage visit not obviously signposted.

name: Historic Belconnen Naval Transmitting Station
reason: Rule 2: heritage precinct viewable from outside only (Wikivoyage: external viewing).
objection: Historic significance; but nothing for a visitor to enter.

name: Cameron Offices
reason: Rule 2: government office seen from outside only.
objection: Wikivoyage calls it a landmark for Brutalist architecture; still exterior-only offices.

name: The Big Powerful Owl
reason: Rule 1/3: Wikivoyage Belconnen names the 8 m Bruce Armstrong sculpture as one of Australia's Big Things (quirky roadside icon, photo stop). Same sculpture as Owl (Armstrong): keep one.
objection: Ten-minute photo stop and a single source.

name: Belconnen Arts Centre
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen and Visit Canberra museums and galleries name it; galleries, Tue-Sun 10-4, on the lake.
objection: Small local arts venue; kept as a gallery with two sources.

name: Strathnairn Arts
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen and Visit Canberra attractions name it; galleries in a 1920s homestead and farm precinct, Wed-Sun.
objection: Local arts venue far from the centre.

name: AIS Arena
reason: Rule 2: indoor sports arena; the visit is the AIS precinct and tours, not the arena.
objection: Wikivoyage lists an AIS precinct and guided tours in Bruce; those would be the candidate, not the arena.

name: Canberra International Sports and Aquatic Centre
reason: Rule 2: leisure/training venue and health club.
objection: Wikivoyage names it with public pools; but a sports facility.

name: The Pinnacle Nature Reserve
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen describes a 154 ha reserve with hike, views over the Molonglo to the Brindabellas and kangaroos.
objection: Only the Wikivoyage page was confirmed; the Visit Canberra 100 things page did not mention it.

name: Shepherds Lookout
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Belconnen: 600 m walk to a platform over the Murrumbidgee, wheelchair friendly; a named lookout.
objection: One source and a short stop; a lookout pull-out.

name: Cooleman Ridge
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Canberra names it among popular bushwalking destinations within the urban parks; reserve with tracks.
objection: Only a name in a list, no detail of what to see; coordinates missing; one source.

name: Hoyts Belconnen
reason: Cinema inside a mall (brief rule: cinemas rejected).
objection: Listed under Wikivoyage; commercial venue.

name: Zone 3 Laser Tag
reason: Commercial entertainment business, not a visitor place.
objection: Long-running local venue; still an activity business.

name: Zone Bowling and Timezone Belconnen
reason: Bowling and arcade business.
objection: Same.

name: Tuggeranong Homestead
reason: Rule 2: Wikivoyage says it is used as a venue for events, conferences and weddings, no public visit named.
objection: Notable pastoral homestead; but not open as an attraction.

name: Tuggeranong Schoolhouse Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage lists the 130-year-old schoolhouse with pastoral-era furniture.
objection: Open only the second Sunday of the month, link dead, one source.

name: Geoscience Australia
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Tuggeranong: education centre of minerals, rocks, fossils, free, weekdays 9-5.
objection: Government agency visitor centre, weekdays only, one source; a short visit.

name: Tuggeranong Arts Centre
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Tuggeranong and Country ACT list galleries and a theatre, Tue-Sat.
objection: Local arts centre mostly a theatre and studios; mostly events, one dead-link listing.
